picks.title: Characterizing Artificial Intelligence Psychosis in a Large Medical Setting
picks.excerpt: A cohort study in a large health system estimates the prevalence of "AI psychosis," characterizes affected patients and defines the role conversational AI played in documented psychotic episodes.
picks.rationale: First health-system cohort quantifying chatbot-linked psychotic episodes in real patients - a patient-safety signal clinicians can act on now.

picks.title: FDA to prioritize guidance on AI, surgical robots next year
picks.excerpt: The FDA device center plans to finalize guidance for AI-enabled devices, draft generative-AI advice and address surgical robots in its fiscal 2027 guidance agenda.
picks.rationale: Official CDRH FY2027 guidance agenda: final AI-device guidance, first generative-AI draft and surgical robots - sets the regulatory roadmap for every AI device maker.

picks.title: VOICE-AE: automated CTCAE scoring from ambient clinical audio using speech recognition and large language models
picks.excerpt: VOICE-AE combines speech recognition, speaker diarization and LLMs to extract and grade treatment-related adverse events (CTCAE) directly from recorded oncology clinic conversations.
picks.rationale: Ambient audio moves beyond note-writing into structured oncology toxicity grading from real clinic visits - a concrete new use of ambient AI.

picks.title: 박유경 교수 "서울아산병원 소아 RRS에 들어온 AI…고위험 환아 조기 선별에 도움"
picks.excerpt: 서울아산병원 소아 신속대응시스템(RRS)에 도입된 뷰노 AI가 데이터 누락과 알람 피로를 보완하며 고위험 환아를 조기에 선별하는 데 도움이 된다는 임상 경험이 소개됐다.
picks.rationale: On-the-ward deployment report: VUNO deterioration AI inside Asan Medical Center's pediatric rapid response system, with clinician experience on alarm fatigue.

picks.title: Standardized pre-consultation by a large language model agent vs ophthalmology residents: a randomized clinical trial
picks.excerpt: A randomized clinical trial at a tertiary ophthalmology center compared a dual-agent LLM pre-consultation history-taking agent against ophthalmology residents.
picks.rationale: RCT pitting an LLM history-taking agent against residents with real patients - randomized evidence for AI in the pre-visit workflow.
